title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: Head of Liquidity
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Liquidity em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business.


Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets.
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance.
  • Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.


FX & Trading Operations

  • Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows.
  • Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing.
  • Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics.
  • Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.


Counterparty & Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties.
  • Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.


Risk & Governance

  • Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight.
  • Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks.
  • Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.


Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead and develop the liquidity function.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.


Requirements

  • Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments.
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices.
  • Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics.
  • Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


Ideal candidate:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews:
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


Flexible working hours.

Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para ser um pilar técnico no desenvolvimento e evolução dos nossos produtos corporativos, com foco principal na criação da nossa nova plataforma interna de Recursos Humanos e Departamento Pessoal. Em um ambiente dinâmico de uma empresa de gestão de saúde, sua missão é atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de soluções de alto impacto.


Você liderará tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de um ecossistema completo que gerenciará a jornada dos nossos colaboradores, desde a admissão virtual e gestão de ponto eletrônico, até o processamento complexo da folha de pagamento. Além de escrever código escalável e de alta qualidade utilizando o ecossistema Node.js e React, você deverá liderar pelo exemplo, mentorar outros desenvolvedores e ditar os padrões de arquitetura da equipe.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código.
  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP):
  • Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros.
  • Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta.
  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).



Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


Ideal candidate:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews:
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


Flexible working hours.

Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. We’re hiring recruiters and HR professionals who deeply understand hiring workflows across Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, and Workday. You’ll help build and evaluate AI systems that support sourcing, recruiting operations, and HR workflows.

  • Create realistic hiring and recruiting workflow scenarios

Nice to have

Offer Details

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)

title: Back-end Engineer | Specialist (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back-end Engineer | Specialist (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetar, implementar e evoluir o gateway central da plataforma de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Definir e implementar padrões de roteamento, autenticação, autorização e controle de tráfego utilizando Kong;
  • Projetar e manter integrações via WebSocket e Webhook em escala, com foco em resiliência e rastreabilidade;
  • Estabelecer contratos de API, políticas de segurança e SLOs para o gateway;
  • Liderar decisões arquiteturais de integração em conjunto com times de segurança, plataforma e negócio;
  • Monitorar e otimizar continuamente performance, latência e disponibilidade do gateway em produção;
  • Produzir documentação arquitetural de referência e conduzir revisões técnicas com os times.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida e comprovada com desenvolvimento backend em Java, Python ou Go;
  • Experiência com exposição de endpoints de modelos de IA/ML e seus padrões específicos de integração;
  • Domínio de Kong ou API gateways equivalentes em ambientes de alta escala, como NGINX, Apigee ou AWS API Gateway;
  • Expertise em protocolos de integração REST, WebSocket, Webhook e gRPC, incluindo design e troubleshooting avançado;
  • Profundo conhecimento de segurança em APIs, incluindo OAuth2, mTLS, JWT, rate limiting e WAF;
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud, preferencialmente AWS, e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Domínio de containers e orquestração em produção com Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimento de service mesh, como Istio ou Linkerd, e suas implicações arquiteturais;
  • Expertise em observabilidade com OpenTelemetry, Datadog e Grafana, com foco em troubleshooting de performance;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, como Kafka ou SQS, em contextos de alta throughput;
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes financeiros regulados, com requisitos rígidos de auditoria e compliance.

  • 7+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência sólida com Java 8+ e Spring Boot/Spring Framework.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços e APIs RESTful.
  • Conhecimento em XML, JSON, Swagger e Maven ou Gradle.
  • Experiência com segurança e autenticação, incluindo mTLS, OAuth2 e AWS Cognito.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL.
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes, Git, filas de mensagens e sistemas de cache.
  • Conhecimento em Jenkins, pipelines CI/CD e boas práticas de deploy.
  • Inglês técnico intermediário ou avançado, com foco em leitura, escrita, interpretação de documentação técnica e participação em interações técnicas com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ambientes Windows e Linux.
  • Experiência com AWS, GCP ou Terraform.
  • Vivência com AWS EC2, EKS, SQS, Redis, DMS ou RDS.
  • Conhecimento em GCP GCE, GKE, Pub/Sub ou DMS.
  • Vivência com PostgreSQL, RDBMS e consultas complexas.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, depuração e troubleshooting, como New Relic ou ferramentas similares.
  • Conhecimento em Shell Script ou Python.
  • Experiência com suporte à produção, gestão de tickets e SLA.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Agile/Scrum.
  • Participação em reuniões técnicas internacionais.
  • Conhecimento em princípios de design responsivo.


Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos uma pessoa com boa capacidade analítica, autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade das entregas e facilidade para colaborar com times multidisciplinares.

É importante ter visão de arquitetura, preocupação com segurança, performance e escalabilidade, além de boa comunicação técnica para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e com interação técnica em inglês.

title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Master Data Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. From large-scale models to agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, this is your moment.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.

-------------



Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.


Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Genpact is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

Furthermore, please do note that Genpact does not charge fees to process job applications and applicants are not required to pay to participate in our hiring process in any other way. Examples of such scams include purchasing a 'starter kit,' paying to apply, or purchasing equipment or training.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Pleno em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com boa autonomia, utilizando as tecnologias, frameworks e padrões adotados nos projetos da BU de Core Banking.
  • Analisar, compreender e evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações, avaliando componentes, integrações, estrutura, segurança e regras de negócio envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir funcionalidades com foco em qualidade, desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Criar, manter e apoiar a evolução de testes manuais e automatizados, contribuindo para a confiabilidade das entregas e para a cobertura dos requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Participar ativamente da definição técnica das soluções, contribuindo com análises, sugestões de melhoria e apoio ao time na tomada de decisão.
  • Documentar implementações, fluxos, decisões técnicas e etapas do desenvolvimento, utilizando ferramentas de versionamento, rastreabilidade e documentação técnica.
  • Realizar detalhamento técnico de demandas em conjunto com clientes, analistas de negócio e demais áreas envolvidas, transformando requisitos funcionais em soluções viáveis, sustentáveis e aderentes à arquitetura definida.
  • Garantir a qualidade do software por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisão de código, padronização e uso adequado de frameworks, servidores de aplicação e ferramentas corporativas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, analistas, QA e áreas parceiras, promovendo alinhamento técnico e funcional ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais com time e cliente, apoiando o esclarecimento de dúvidas, o refinamento de escopo e a evolução contínua das soluções.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência com Java JDK 8 ou 17
  • Vivência com Spring Boot, JAX-WS, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, JEE, JSF, EJB e AngularJS
  • Experiência com WildFly 11 e/ou 18
  • Conhecimento em construção e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Experiência com Keycloak , utilizando OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (Bearer Token)
  • Conhecimento sólido em JPA / Hibernate
  • Experiência com banco de dados Oracle
  • Vivência com Git
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento e princípios de design como SOLID
  • Vivência com Maven para build e gerenciamento de dependências
  • Experiência em análise, desenvolvimento, manutenção e sustentação de sistemas corporativos
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na análise e solução de problemas técnicos
  • Boa comunicação para interação com time técnico, áreas de negócio e clientes


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :


  • Vivência em sustentação, suporte e atendimento a clientes em ambientes corporativos
  • Experiência com SQL Server ou ORACLE
  • Conhecimento em Kafka para mensageria e integração entre sistemas
  • Atuação em times que utilizam Métodos Ágeis
  • Vivência no uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao desenvolvimento de software , com foco em produtividade, apoio à análise técnica, documentação, testes e troubleshooting


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:


️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Gerente de projetos SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de projetos SAP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP relacionados à implementação dos requisitos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e demais impactos regulatórios).
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamento, riscos, dependências e indicadores dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos legais, processos de negócio e soluções sistêmicas.
  • Atuar na gestão de fornecedores e consultorias parceiras.
  • Liderar as fases de levantamento, desenho de solução, testes integrados, homologação e go-live.
  • Gerenciar riscos, impactos e mudanças de escopo, assegurando a governança do projeto.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias para adequação fiscal e tributária nos ambientes SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos adotadas pela organização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação, rollout, conversão ou transformação SAP.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas e apresentações para alta liderança.
  • Conhecimento dos processos fiscais e integrações entre módulos SAP.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência com soluções fiscais como DRC, Soficom, Tax One, Mastersaf, Synchro, Guepardo, Vertex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

title: Master Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Master Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. From large-scale models to agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, this is your moment.

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an advanced technology services and solutions company that delivers lasting value for leading enterprises globally. Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.

-------------



Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.


Genpact is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. Genpact is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

Furthermore, please do note that Genpact does not charge fees to process job applications and applicants are not required to pay to participate in our hiring process in any other way. Examples of such scams include purchasing a 'starter kit,' paying to apply, or purchasing equipment or training.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Você fará parte de um ambiente técnico colaborativo, atuando em parceria com times de arquitetura, produto, QA e operação para construir soluções robustas, seguras, escaláveis e preparadas para alta disponibilidade.

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções baseadas em microsserviços utilizando Java, Spring Boot e tecnologias relacionadas.

  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura de sistemas e integrações, garantindo soluções robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Transformar definições técnicas de alto nível em soluções executáveis.

  • Atuar em demandas de suporte, melhorias, mudanças e evolução de requisitos ao longo do ciclo de release.
  • Documentar procedimentos técnicos, fases de testes, recomendações e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Participar de testes, garantia de qualidade e integração de aplicações.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho da equipe e apoiar a melhoria dos processos técnicos.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 7+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência sólida com Java 8+ e Spring Boot/Spring Framework.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços e APIs RESTful.
  • Conhecimento em XML, JSON, Swagger e Maven ou Gradle.
  • Experiência com segurança e autenticação, incluindo mTLS, OAuth2 e AWS Cognito.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL.
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes, Git, filas de mensagens e sistemas de cache.
  • Conhecimento em Jenkins, pipelines CI/CD e boas práticas de deploy.
  • Inglês técnico intermediário ou avançado, com foco em leitura, escrita, interpretação de documentação técnica e participação em interações técnicas com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em Angular, Node.js ou atuação full stack.
  • Experiência com ambientes Windows e Linux.
  • Experiência com AWS, GCP ou Terraform.
  • Vivência com AWS EC2, EKS, SQS, Redis, DMS ou RDS.
  • Conhecimento em GCP GCE, GKE, Pub/Sub ou DMS.
  • Vivência com PostgreSQL, RDBMS e consultas complexas.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, depuração e troubleshooting, como New Relic ou ferramentas similares.
  • Conhecimento em Shell Script ou Python.
  • Experiência com suporte à produção, gestão de tickets e SLA.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Agile/Scrum.
  • Participação em reuniões técnicas internacionais.
  • Conhecimento em princípios de design responsivo.


Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos uma pessoa com boa capacidade analítica, autonomia técnica, atenção à qualidade das entregas e facilidade para colaborar com times multidisciplinares.

É importante ter visão de arquitetura, preocupação com segurança, performance e escalabilidade, além de boa comunicação técnica para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e com interação técnica em inglês.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O Centro de Integração Empresa Escola - CIEE é uma instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos e de fins não econômicos, reconhecida como entidade de assistência social que, por meio de diversos programas, dentre eles o de aprendizagem e o estágio de estudantes, possibilita aos adolescentes e jovens uma formação integral, ingressando-os ao mundo do trabalho.


O CIEE tem um programa de diversidade que acolhe e respeita como você é e como quiser ser!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Construir e manter aplicações web (frontend e backend), além de definir boas práticas a serem adotadas pelo CIEE.
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST, garantindo integração eficiente entre sistemas internos e externos.
  • Escrever testes unitários e revisar código (code review).
  • Traduzir requisitos, estórias e regras de negócio em soluções eficientes.
  • Definir arquitetura de software e banco de dados.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, refatorar e resolver débitos técnicos nos sistemas implantados.
  • Documentar todas as atividades desenvolvidas, fluxos, integrações e regras de negócio.
  • Estimar esforço, prazo e impedimentos para cada demanda.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis (planejamento, dailies, retrospectivas e revisões).
  • Direcionar estagiários e desenvolvedores na execução de demandas.
  • Manter arquivos, registros e controles da área atualizados e acessíveis.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior concluído em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.


  • Experiência: em atividades de desenvolvimento de software.


  • Conhecimentos específicos: Linguagens e Frameworks (Domínio em ao menos uma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos: Java, PHP ou Python. Domínio de desenvolvimento web: HTML, CSS e JavaScript. Domínio de frameworks backend Spring Boot. Banco de Dados (Domínio com SQL e banco de dados relacional (Oracle ou MySQL) e Experiência com modelagem de dados.). Versionamento e Colaboração ( Git e fluxo de versionamento (commits, branches e pull requests). Integração e Arquitetura ( Domínio de APIs REST (criação e consumo) e Domínio com microsserviços e componentização). Qualidade de Software ( Experiência com testes unitários e Domínio com Clean Code e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.). Metodologia ( Experiência com métodos ágeis: Scrum e/ou Kanban)Infraestrutura (básico): Experiência com Docker (criação de imagens e containers) e Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.


Horário: 08:00 às 17:30 - segunda à sexta

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack SR | Java / React
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack SR | Java / React em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Liderar o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações e serviços de alta performance utilizando Java e Micronaut .
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços , mensageria e eventos utilizando Kafka .
  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas, responsivas e escaláveis com React e TypeScript .
  • Modelar, otimizar e manter bancos de dados PostgreSQL , garantindo performance e confiabilidade.
  • Definir e implementar padrões de segurança, observabilidade, monitoramento e resiliência em ambientes AWS .
  • Realizar code reviews, garantindo qualidade, manutenibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar a investigação e resolução de incidentes, conduzindo análises de causa raiz e ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, compartilhando conhecimento e apoiando o desenvolvimento de profissionais de diferentes níveis.
  • Participar ativamente de definições arquiteturais e decisões técnicas de longo prazo.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Experiência sólida com Java 11+ e frameworks modernos para desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços, preferencialmente Micronaut .
  • Domínio de React , TypeScript e conceitos modernos de desenvolvimento Front-End.
  • Experiência avançada com Apache Kafka , incluindo tópicos, partições, consumer groups, estratégias de processamento e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em PostgreSQL , modelagem de dados, otimização de consultas e performance tuning.
  • Experiência com serviços AWS , incluindo recursos de infraestrutura, integração e monitoramento.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas distribuídas, sistemas escaláveis e padrões de integração.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD , testes automatizados e infraestrutura como código.
  • Experiência atuando em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e apoiando decisões arquiteturais.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com DataDog, OpenTelemetry, Feature Flags ou ferramentas similares de observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , CQRS e Event Sourcing .
  • Atuação prévia como Tech Lead ou referência técnica em squads de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas de alta disponibilidade, tolerância a falhas e ambientes multi-região.




Importante: Para seguirmos com a avaliação técnica dos candidatos, será necessário realizar um teste técnico compatível com as atividades e tecnologias da posição. Essa etapa faz parte do processo seletivo e tem como objetivo avaliar conhecimentos práticos relacionados ao desafio da vaga.

Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products.

As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule.

If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth.

Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity.

Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps
  • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release
  • Process Optimization: Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments
  • Market Insight: Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class


Required Experience

  • Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills
  • Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment
  • MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising
  • Agile Software: Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning
  • Data Literacy: Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers
  • Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists
  • Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process
  • Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward
  • High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Marketing Platforms: Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Pleno -SUSEP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo(a) de Vendas Pleno -SUSEP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Seguros Unimed, a Seguradora do Sistema Unimed, uma empresa criada por médicos e que tem o cooperativismo na essência. Cuidamos das instituições e das pessoas, para que possam viver bem o presente e planejar o futuro com segurança. Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer soluções completas, que potencializem novos negócios. E estamos ao lado dos nossos clientes na hora em que mais precisam. Acreditamos que a cooperação nos conecta para crescermos juntos.


Pelo 7º ano consecutivo, a Seguros Unimed integra o ranking dos Lugares Mais Incríveis para Trabalhar 2025 , da FIA e do Estadão. E este ano, alcançamos o patamar MÁXIMO: somos O MAIS INCRÍVEL!


O que oferecemos nessa Jornada:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • PPR - Programa de Participação nos Resultados;
  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Vale transporte ou desconto em estacionamento;
  • Seguro Saúde;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Assistência a Viagens;
  • Garantia Funeral;
  • Auxílio Creche ou Babá;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Convênio com academia;
  • Happy Day - um dia de folga no aniversário.



Além disso, você encontra por aqui:

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento;
  • Plataforma exclusiva com treinamentos;
  • Diversas parcerias e descontos pela região.


No seu dia-a-dia:


  • Realizar as atividades de vendas corporativas, planos e iniciativas de gestão e relacionamento comercial com clientes diferenciados com médio impacto financeiro, realizando prospecções e ofertas, entendendo necessidades realizando contatos e visitas para mapeamento e/ou monitoramento da qualidade e grau de satisfação dos produtos adquiridos da Seguros Unimed, buscando e avaliando informações que permitam a criação, atendimento a novas demandas e promoção de alterações em contratos/condições comerciais e/ou no desenvolvimento/produção de produtos, assegurando nível de satisfação e continuidade de contratos;
  • Realizar visitas aos clientes, identificar e oferecer através de análise do potencial de negócios do cliente, novos serviços, buscando alavancar negócios de pós vendas, desenvolvendo soluções para renovações e up grade das contas ativas da Cia;
  • Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;
  • Responsável pelo relacionamento com o cliente, visando assegurar a satisfação, atendimento, fidelização, rentabilização e a retenção dos clientes de todos os segmentos de negócios da Seguros Unimed;
  • Realizar negociações dentro dos padrões e normas definidas pela empresa, através da orientação, análise e validação dos contratos comerciais, acompanhamento e monitoramento dos processos de negociações;
  • Realizar vendas de produtos e soluções, de contas de médio porte e impacto financeiro, buscando o atingimento das metas de vendas, através do acompanhamento dos resultados, elaboração de planos de ações para expansão do mercado e desenvolvimento de novos mercados;
  • Manter cadastro de clientes atualizado, bem como manter-se informado do potencial e situação financeira dos mesmos;
  • Identificar novas demandas externas, quais as necessidades e o potencial do mercado, desenvolvendo novos clientes e buscando continuamente novas oportunidades de negócios para a empresa;
  • Promover e fortalecer a imagem da empresa no mercado, cumprindo a estratégia e plano de ações de marketing, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de divulgação e disseminação dos produtos, soluções e marca, monitorando efetividade das ações mercadológicas;
  • Organizar toda a demanda ou processos advindos do escritório regional, corretoras ou a pessoa jurídica, sendo resolutivo, revendo prazos, rotinas e assegurando treinamentos quando identificada a necessidade de melhorias, alinhada ao perfil do cliente;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho do mercado e da concorrência, procurando conhecer os produtos e a similaridade dos mesmos com os produtos da empresa.;
  • Participar ativamente de programas de melhoria da qualidade dos produtos, serviços e meio ambiente, cumprir as normas internas e de segurança do trabalho;
  • Prestar suporte aos clientes e parceiros, no que se refere às peculiaridades da empresa, contribuindo com a melhoria dos serviços a serem prestados;
  • Buscar a geração de novas oportunidades, mediante identificação dos pontos que podem ser trabalhados no cliente, imaginando e propondo soluções;
  • Contribuir para soluções técnicas e aperfeiçoamento técnico dos produtos através de informações de mercado;
  • Controlar reclamações de clientes, fazendo follow-up na área competente para retorno e devolução rápida, bem como acompanhar a resolução de problemas internos do pós venda;
  • Elaborar relatórios de vendas, especificando os resultados obtidos e mantendo o superior hierárquico informado sobre o andamento das vendas, volume de vendas e tendências futuras do mercado;
  • Cumprir o regulamento interno, normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho inerentes ao setor, bem como as observações dos requisitos de compliance, observação e o cumprimento das regulamentações atinentes à empresa;
  • Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência;




Esperamos de você:

  • Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Economia ou área afins.
  • Habilitação - CNH (obrigatório);
  • Informática – Pacote Office;
  • Foco em Resultados e Execução;
  • Boa comunicação;


*Importante ter disponibilidade para viagens.



Informações adicionais

  • Vaga extensiva a Pessoa com Deficiência - PcD;
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT
  • Horário de trabalho: de segunda a sexta-feira, comercial flexível;
  • Local de trabalho: Salvador - BA
  • Todos os nossos processos seletivos são totalmente online nas etapas iniciais.


A Seguros Unimed respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso de uma empresa focada em cooperar e no seu cliente interno e externo.

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge.
