title: Senior SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior SAP Basis Consultant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior SAP Basis Consultant

Location: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Senior SAP Technology Consultant to join our client's team in the enterprise technology sector. In this role, you will contribute to executing complex SAP environments, focusing on S/4HANA conversions and cloud operations, ensuring system stability and driving technical decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Execution of readiness checks, CVI, and SDM/SDNI processes for S/4HANA conversions and migrations.
  • Perform end-to-end kernel upgrade execution and manage file distribution across instances.
  • Conduct full lifecycle SUM execution, including SPDD/SPAU adjustments and troubleshooting upgrade issues.
  • Install and maintain SAP add-ons via SAP Patch Manager (SPAM) and handle Transport of Copies (TOC) for transport management.
  • Analyze work processes and troubleshoot performance issues using tools like SM50/SM66 and dpmon.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (Shell, Python) for upgrades, monitoring, and routine tasks.
  • Act as the final escalation point for complex issues, performing root cause analysis and system recovery.

Requirements

  • Strong practical expertise in SAP Migrations to S/4HANA and Upgrades.
  • Up to 12 years of SAP Basis experience.
  • Advanced English proficiency for global communication.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of HANA, NetWeaver, Linux, HA/DR, and automation/scripting (Shell, Python).
  • Experience with SAP Solution Manager or Focused Run for system monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications (if any)

  • SAP certifications (S/4HANA, HANA, Cloud).
  • Experience with SAP BTP.
  • Experience in Lift & Shift, Brownfield, and Greenfield migration approaches.

Salary & Benefits (Optional)

(Include the pay range if available and highlight benefits: e.g., health coverage, training, hybrid work, etc.)

Who We Are

SGF Global is an integrated talent solutions provider, offering staffing, recruitment, Employer of Record (EOR), nearshore, and consulting services across a wide range of industries in 35 countries. We’re a dynamic, people-first organization where fresh ideas are always welcome. Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and a genuine passion for helping people grow. At SGF Global, smiles are part of the dress code, and every voice matters.

Are you looking to join an organization where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your work makes a global impact?

  • Grow your career
  • Be part of something global
  • Your future starts here.

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular) — Financial Technology
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Full-Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular) — Financial Technology em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role:

We are looking for a passionate, innovative, and highly technical Lead Full-Stack Developer to join a small, elite, and agile team of technologists. In this role, you will lead the architecture and development of next-generation software solutions utilized daily by our Risk Management teams and Portfolio Managers to make mission-critical trading decisions.

To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent, problem-solving mindset while deeply enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value true \"ownership\" engineers who have comprehensive full-lifecycle software experience—from requirements gathering and heavy-performance implementation to testing, release, and continuous support.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and low-latency financial systems using C# and modern .NET Core.
  • Performance Optimization: Benchmark, profile, and tune memory management, GC allocation, thread utilization, and heavy SQL workflows to ensure real-time transaction speeds.
  • Front-End Integration: Collaborate with front-office stakeholders to deliver responsive, data-heavy web interfaces using Angular.
  • Technical Leadership: Champion clean code architectures, SOLID design principles, and Test-Driven Development (TDD) workflows across a small team of engineers.
  • Domain Integration: Work closely with Risk Managers and Quants to turn complex business requirements (e.g., real-time pricing, scenario modeling) into high-throughput software.


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional backend development experience, ideally within the Hedge Fund, Asset Management, or Fintech/Financial Services industries .
  • Engineering Excellence: Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID design principles, and Clean/Hexagonal Architecture patterns.
  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills with the ability to bridge technical jargon with front-office financial requirements.


Technical Skillset Matrix:


Core Tech Stack:

  • Backend: C#, .NET Core / .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Frontend: JavaScript / TypeScript / Modern Angular Frameworks
  • Database: Advanced RDBMS, complex data modeling, and deep relational database design.
  • Web Services: RESTful APIs, gRPC, and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA / SOAP).

High-Performance & Concurrency Mastery:

  • Asynchronous & Multi-threading: Advanced knowledge of Async/Await patterns, Task Parallel Library (TPL), concurrency controls, and hard-core thread safety.
  • Systems Engineering: Proven hands-on experience building low-latency, high-performance, and scalable distributed architectures.
  • System Diagnostics: High proficiency in memory management, garbage collection (GC) tuning, performance profiling, and SQL query optimization.


Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills):

  • Financial Domain: Direct familiarity with financial instruments (Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives).
  • Risk Engine Exposure: Experience building portfolio analytics pipelines, real-time pricing engines, or \"What-If\" scenario calculators.
  • DevOps & Testing: Solid practice of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD pipelines.


If you are ready to build cutting-edge front-office trading tools and own your code from architecture to production deployment, apply today!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial Intelligence Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer to join the Customer Delivery team at CI&T.

This person will work embedded within strategic client projects, helping companies across industries such as banking, insurance, and retail successfully adopt and operationalize Generative AI solutions in real production environments.

The challenge involves building and scaling AI-powered solutions such as RAG pipelines, AI agents, and intelligent automations while enabling client teams to operate autonomously and evolve their engineering capabilities.

We are looking for someone hands-on, highly technical, and passionate about applying AI to solve real business and engineering problems at scale.


Responsibilities

Build and operationalize Generative AI solutions within client projects, ensuring value delivery from the beginning of the engagement.

Develop and evolve RAG pipelines, AI agents, intelligent automations, and integrations with LLMs in production environments.

Design and implement AI-assisted engineering solutions to improve software development lifecycle efficiency and quality.

Support technical discovery, architecture definition, and technical decision-making across projects.

Enable and mentor client engineering teams, accelerating adoption of AI solutions and modern engineering practices.

Collaborate with engagement managers, technical teams, and stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical implementation and business goals.

Evaluate technical contexts, constraints, and existing architectures at the beginning of engagements.

Build proof of concepts (POCs) and validate technical approaches before scaling implementations.

Contribute to software architecture, APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and cloud-native environments.

Create and maintain clear technical documentation and operational guidelines.


Requirements for this challenge

Experience in software engineering and modern distributed systems.

Hands-on experience with Generative AI solutions in production environments.

Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering solutions.

Experience integrating and consuming LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar.

Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar solutions.

Experience building or integrating AI agents and AI-assisted development workflows.

Knowledge of backend development using Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, or similar languages.

Knowledge of APIs, REST services, contracts, and versioning.

Experience with distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including AI services like Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI.

Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD, testing, and automation.

Experience with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

Ability to work across multiple client engagements and contexts simultaneously.

Advanced English communication skills.

Strong communication, collaboration, and technical influence skills.


Differentials

Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.

Experience with AI-assisted modernization and legacy migration strategies.

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular) — Financial Technology
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Full-Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular) — Financial Technology em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role:

We are looking for a passionate, innovative, and highly technical Lead Full-Stack Developer to join a small, elite, and agile team of technologists. In this role, you will lead the architecture and development of next-generation software solutions utilized daily by our Risk Management teams and Portfolio Managers to make mission-critical trading decisions.

To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent, problem-solving mindset while deeply enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value true \"ownership\" engineers who have comprehensive full-lifecycle software experience—from requirements gathering and heavy-performance implementation to testing, release, and continuous support.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design and implementation of highly scalable, distributed, and low-latency financial systems using C# and modern .NET Core.
  • Performance Optimization: Benchmark, profile, and tune memory management, GC allocation, thread utilization, and heavy SQL workflows to ensure real-time transaction speeds.
  • Front-End Integration: Collaborate with front-office stakeholders to deliver responsive, data-heavy web interfaces using Angular.
  • Technical Leadership: Champion clean code architectures, SOLID design principles, and Test-Driven Development (TDD) workflows across a small team of engineers.
  • Domain Integration: Work closely with Risk Managers and Quants to turn complex business requirements (e.g., real-time pricing, scenario modeling) into high-throughput software.


Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of professional backend development experience, ideally within the Hedge Fund, Asset Management, or Fintech/Financial Services industries .
  • Engineering Excellence: Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID design principles, and Clean/Hexagonal Architecture patterns.
  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills with the ability to bridge technical jargon with front-office financial requirements.


Technical Skillset Matrix:


Core Tech Stack:

  • Backend: C#, .NET Core / .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Frontend: JavaScript / TypeScript / Modern Angular Frameworks
  • Database: Advanced RDBMS, complex data modeling, and deep relational database design.
  • Web Services: RESTful APIs, gRPC, and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA / SOAP).

High-Performance & Concurrency Mastery:

  • Asynchronous & Multi-threading: Advanced knowledge of Async/Await patterns, Task Parallel Library (TPL), concurrency controls, and hard-core thread safety.
  • Systems Engineering: Proven hands-on experience building low-latency, high-performance, and scalable distributed architectures.
  • System Diagnostics: High proficiency in memory management, garbage collection (GC) tuning, performance profiling, and SQL query optimization.


Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills):

  • Financial Domain: Direct familiarity with financial instruments (Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives).
  • Risk Engine Exposure: Experience building portfolio analytics pipelines, real-time pricing engines, or \"What-If\" scenario calculators.
  • DevOps & Testing: Solid practice of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD pipelines.


If you are ready to build cutting-edge front-office trading tools and own your code from architecture to production deployment, apply today!

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking to hire a Senior Payments Engineer to help build a next-generation payment orchestration platform.



Our company operates in the payments space today, and this role will be instrumental in designing and building the infrastructure that sits between merchants, gateways, processors, and acquiring banks.


The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on experience with modern payment platforms such as Adyen and/or Stripe and understands payment flows at a systems level.

Key Areas of Experience

  • Direct experience building integrations with Adyen and/or Stripe APIs
  • Experience with payment orchestration, intelligent routing, gateway abstraction, and multi-processor environments
  • Deep understanding of card processing, authorization flows, settlement processes, tokenization, vaulting, recurring billing, and end-to-end payment lifecycle management
  • Strong backend engineering background, including API architecture, distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization
  • Experience with PCI compliance, fraud prevention, risk controls, payment security, and regulatory requirements
  • Proven track record building payment infrastructure and core payment systems—not simply consuming third-party payment APIs

Preferred / Bonus Experience

  • Merchant acquiring, sponsor bank relationships, ISO/MSP environments, or PayFac (Payment Facilitator) models
  • High-volume transaction processing systems
  • Alternative payment methods, ACH, digital wallets, and international payment processing
  • Building payment gateways, gateway routing engines, processor-agnostic payment platforms, or payment orchestration layers

Role Expectations

This individual will play a key role in architecting the platform, making critical technical decisions, and owning significant portions of the payments infrastructure. We are looking for someone who can operate strategically at the systems-design level while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in implementation.

title: SR Desenvolvimento Back-end (Java)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SR Desenvolvimento Back-end (Java) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Sênior com foco em Java para atuar em um projeto novo, com forte protagonismo técnico. Você será responsável por desenhar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis baseadas em microsserviços e APIs, contribuindo com decisões de arquitetura em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a produto. Buscamos alguém que una excelência técnica e visão de negócio, atuando como referência para o time.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços backend utilizando Java e Spring Boot;
  • Projetar e evoluir microsserviços com abordagem API-first, seguindo a metodologia SOA (orientação a serviços);
  • Desenvolver e consumir APIs RESTful seguindo as melhores práticas;
  • Desenvolver e otimizar stored procedures e atuar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Contribuir com decisões de arquitetura e melhorias contínuas nos sistemas existentes;
  • Atuar com esteira de CI/CD, apoiando a integração e entrega contínua;
  • Apoiar a migração e modernização de soluções em nuvem;
  • Colaborar com o time de forma organizada e proativa, participando de cerimônias e discussões técnicas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e atuar como referência técnica, contribuindo para a evolução do time.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com Java (versões atuais e atualizadas) e Spring Boot;
  • Experiência com microsserviços e arquitetura API-first;
  • Conhecimento sólido em APIs RESTful (obrigatório);
  • Vivência com esteira de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com Jenkins (não é necessário operar em produção, mas saber utilizá-lo no contexto de desenvolvimento);
  • Experiência com SQL Server e desenvolvimento de stored procedures;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MongoDB, Redis, uso de cache);
  • Experiência com OpenShift, Kubernetes e containers;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia SOA (orientação a serviços);
  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia — utilizamos Copilot e estamos desenvolvendo uma IA própria;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e perfil colaborativo.


Diferencial ou Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no setor de seguros;
  • Gerenciamento de APIs, especialmente IBM API Connect (APIC);
  • Ferramentas de DevSecOps;
  • Experiência ou contato com AWS (estamos iniciando nossa migração para a nuvem AWS).


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Sobre a vaga


Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente , com mais de 4 anos de prática e domínio de Java 8+ , esta vaga pode ser ideal para você.

  • Análise de logs, profiling e troubleshooting

  • Hibernate
  • Oracle e PostgreSQL
  • Redis

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Ukraine / Moldova)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Ukraine / Moldova) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Hitch equips traditional lenders with the tools they need to transform into home equity fintech companies. Through our comprehensive, white-label platform, we streamline the entire lending process—from customer application to loan officer management and connections with capital markets partners. Our mission is to simplify and modernize access to home equity solutions, empowering financial institutions to deliver better services. Hitch's platform is designed to be efficient, scalable, and adaptable to meet the needs of a changing market.


Role Description

We are seeking a skilled Senior Full-Stack Engineer for a contract position that is fully remote, limited to candidates in Brazil. In this role, you will develop, optimize, and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our white-label platform. Responsibilities include building and refining user interfaces, ensuring seamless integration with back-end systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance solutions. You will also contribute to software architecture decisions, write clean and scalable code, and troubleshoot technical issues as they arise.


Qualifications

  • Experience in Full-Stack Development, including both Front-End Development and Back-End Web Development
  • Proficiency in Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and building responsive, user-friendly interfaces
  • Strong background in Software Development with a focus on scalable and maintainable code
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with teams and adapt to a fast-paced, remote work environment
  • Familiarity with modern development frameworks and tools
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is a plus
  • Previous experience in financial or fintech-related projects is an advantage

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Video Editor - DTC Brand


Location: Fully Remote (must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. Our marketing team is scaling rapidly, and we're looking for a video editor who wants to grow their skills in performance marketing while building a long-term role with a mission-driven company.


The Role

You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. You'll work with a steady flow of creator and product footage, turning it into thumb-stopping content that performs. This isn't agency churn-and-burn; you'll see what converts, iterate based on data, and refine your craft with real-time feedback.


What You'll Do

Video Editing & Production

  • Create high-performing Facebook/Instagram ad creatives and social media clips
  • Edit short-form content optimized for platform-specific formats
  • Source and organize B-roll and stock footage using the provided subscriptions
  • Manage creator content in Frame.io and maintain organized asset libraries

Graphic Design & Assets

  • Design marketing images, thumbnails, and social graphics
  • Create on-brand visual assets using Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

Project Management

  • Track assignments and status updates in ClickUp
  • Follow naming conventions and file organization protocols
  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of video editing experience, specializing in short-form content
  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

title: EDI Developer (Remote | PJ)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para EDI Developer (Remote | PJ) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

100% Remote

PJ / Contractor

Fluent English


EDI Developer (B2B / Integration)


Overview

We are seeking an experienced EDI Developer to support a growing integration and data ecosystem. This role will focus on designing, implementing, and maintaining EDI solutions that enable seamless data exchange with external partners, vendors, and customers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain EDI integrations (X12, EDIFACT) across key business functions (order management, logistics, finance, etc.)
  • Build and support inbound and outbound EDI transactions (e.g., 850, 855, 856, 810, 820, 940/945)
  • Collaborate with Integration Engineers to implement and manage EDI workflows using iPaaS platforms (Workato or similar)
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure EDI data is accurately integrated into Snowflake/Databricks for downstream analytics and reporting
  • Develop and maintain data mappings, transformations, and validation logic
  • Troubleshoot EDI issues, manage error handling, and ensure timely resolution of data discrepancies
  • Work with business stakeholders and external trading partners to onboard new EDI integrations and maintain existing relationships
  • Ensure compliance with EDI standards, partner specifications, and data governance requirements
  • Document EDI processes, mappings, and integration architecture

Required Qualifications

  • Solid experience in EDI development and integration
  • Strong experience with EDI standards (ANSI X12, EDIFACT) and common transaction sets (850, 856, 810, etc.)
  • Experience with EDI mapping and transformation tools (Sterling, SPS Commerce, Cleo, Boomi, or similar)
  • Experience working with APIs, file-based integrations (SFTP, AS2), and data transformation concepts
  • Understanding of ERP integrations (NetSuite, SAP, or similar)
  • Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks
  • Strong SQL skills and understanding of data structures and pipelines
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working alongside iPaaS platforms (Workato preferred)
  • Exposure to ETL/ELT workflows and collaboration with Data Engineering teams (dbt, Python a plus)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, version control (Git), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Experience in CPG, retail, or supply chain environments
  • Knowledge of EDI communication protocols (AS2, FTP/SFTP, VANs)

Create scroll-stopping content for a scaling DTC brand. We need a performance-focused video editor who can turn raw footage into high-converting ads and social content - with creative freedom and direct feedback loops on what's working.

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, eco-friendly pet care brand expanding across major retailers like Walmart, Target, and Chewy. You'll be our go-to editor for short-form video content that drives sales—think Facebook/Instagram ads, TikTok content, and social clips. Video Editing & Production

  • Communicate proactively about timelines, blockers, and questions


Requirements

  • Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills (required)
  • Proven experience creating or editing Facebook/Instagram ads
  • Mid-level proficiency with Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva
  • Strong fundamentals in typography, color theory, composition, and motion graphics
  • Fluent English — excellent written and verbal communication
  • Self-managed — strong time management and ability to meet daily/weekly deadlines
  • Proactive communicator — asks questions early, flags issues before they become problems
  • Portfolio required — you must submit a portfolio showcasing your video editing work. Applications without portfolios will not be considered.


Nice to Have

  • Background in DTC or e-commerce brands
  • Experience with remote collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Frame.io, Notion)
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics and what makes ads convert


Tech Requirements

Computer: i7 processor (or equivalent) with 16GB RAM minimum

Internet: 100 Mbps download speed minimum

Schedule

Monday-Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (1-hour break)

Required: Weekly team meeting on Thursdays at 10:00 AM EST



Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire.
  • Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business


Ready to Apply?

If you love creating high-performing video content and have a portfolio that showcases your work, we want to see it. Apply now.

Note: Applications without portfolio samples will not be reviewed.

Confira esta oportunidade para DevOps Engineer w/ Azure and Terraform- Relocation to Portugal em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 5 years working in a related area (e.g: Infra, software engineer)
  • +3 years of working experience as a Devops Engineer ;
  • Solid professional experience with Azure Cloud;
  • Professional experience with Kubernetes and Terraform ;
  • Fluency in English (B2+);
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.


For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior (JavaScript)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor FullStack Sênior (JavaScript) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Atividades


Desenvolvimento Frontend

  • Criar e manter interfaces performáticas e responsivas utilizando React.js e Next.js;
  • Implementar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando React Hooks, Context API e bibliotecas como Zustand/Redux;
  • Garantir SEO e performance através de SSR, ISR e otimizações de carregamento;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de acessibilidade (Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse);
  • Integrar bibliotecas de UI como Material-UI, Tailwind CSS ou ShadCN/UI;
  • Criar e manter testes unitários utilizando Jest, React Testing Library e Cypress/Playwright.

Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Criar APIs escaláveis utilizando Node.js com NestJS, Express ou Fastify;
  • Construir arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços e aplicações serverless (AWS Lambda, Firebase Functions);
  • Desenvolver e otimizar APIs REST e GraphQL garantindo segurança e performance;
  • Implementar comunicação em tempo real com WebSockets e eventos assíncronos;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis);
  • Utilizar mensageria com Kafka, RabbitMQ ou SQS para processamento de eventos;
  • Aplicar práticas avançadas de testes unitários e integração com Jest, Mocha e Supertest.

Infraestrutura e DevOps

  • Criar pipelines de CI/CD automatizados utilizando GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou CircleCI;
  • Utilizar Docker e Kubernetes para deploy escalável e gerenciamento de containers;
  • Monitorar logs e métricas com Prometheus, Grafana, ELK ou Datadog;
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura em cloud, preferencialmente AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, API Gateway, IAM);
  • Implementar segurança na aplicação com JWT, OAuth, OpenID e RBAC.


Requisitos da Vaga

  • Experiência sólida com React.js, Next.js e seu ecossistema;
  • Conhecimento avançado em TypeScript para garantir tipagem segura e escalabilidade;
  • Domínio de Node.js e frameworks como NestJS, Express ou Fastify;
  • Experiência com GraphQL e APIs REST (otimização e segurança);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis);
  • Experiência com mensageria e eventos assíncronos (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS);
  • Vivência com WebSockets e comunicação em tempo real;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes para deploy escalável;
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em AWS, Terraform e CloudFormation;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e integração (Jest, Mocha, Supertest).

title: Especialista Product Designer (Remoto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Product Designer (Remoto) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Especialista em Design de Produto para atuar de forma transversal na evolução da experiência dos produtos da Suíte Logística. Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de design, elevando a qualidade visual e de interação, promovendo maior consistência entre soluções e contribuindo para a construção de uma experiência integrada de plataforma. Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade de execução, pensamento sistêmico e excelência em UX e UI, que atue como referência técnica para o time e ajude a transformar desafios complexos em experiências simples, intuitivas e de alto valor para os usuários.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução da experiência de uma plataforma composta por múltiplos produtos;
  • Atuar na construção de soluções digitais complexas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e simplicidade para os usuários;
  • Participar ativamente da construção e evolução de soluções, atuando de forma hands-on em fluxos, interfaces e protótipos quando necessário;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da maturidade do time de design por meio de mentorias, direcionamentos técnicos e disseminação de boas práticas;
  • Participar da definição e execução de fluxos, interfaces, protótipos e padrões de experiência;
  • Promover a evolução da qualidade visual e de interação dos produtos;
  • Conduzir revisões críticas e direcionamentos técnicos para designers e squads multidisciplinares;
  • Contribuir para a evolução de design systems, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Influenciar decisões de produto e experiência por meio de uma visão sistêmica e orientada ao usuário;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Design de Produto (UX/UI) em produtos digitais;
  • Ensino superior completo em Design, Design Digital, Design de Interação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em UX, Design de Produto, Inovação ou áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência consolidada em Design de Produto, atuando em plataformas, produtos digitais ou ecossistemas de média e alta complexidade;
  • Vivência em produtos SaaS, plataformas ou sistemas de alta complexidade;
  • Atuação como referência técnica, mentor ou líder de prática em times de design;
  • Experiência atuando de forma transversal em múltiplos produtos, jornadas ou domínios de negócio;
  • Forte capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em experiências simples e intuitivas;
  • Domínio de processos de descoberta, definição e entrega de soluções digitais;
  • Experiência na criação de fluxos, arquitetura da informação, prototipação e interfaces;
  • Experiência conduzindo decisões de design em ambientes multidisciplinares e de alta complexidade;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com Produto, Tecnologia e demais áreas do negócio;
  • Pensamento sistêmico e visão estratégica aplicada à experiência do usuário;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de influenciar decisões sem autoridade formal;


DIFERENCIAL

  • Experiência com plataformas compostas por múltiplos produtos ou ecossistemas digitais;
  • Vivência na construção e evolução de Design Systems;
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação ou modernização de produtos legados;
  • Experiência em ambientes B2B;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de experiência e indicadores de produto;
  • Familiaridade com inteligência artificial aplicada à experiência do usuário.

title: HubSpot Administrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para HubSpot Administrator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

HubSpot Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong teams across technology, operations, and customer-facing functions. Our trusted technology partner is seeking a HubSpot Administrator to support and optimise its HubSpot ecosystem across marketing, sales, and service operations.


Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced HubSpot Administrator to support daily HubSpot operations, maintain system efficiency, optimise workflows, and ensure the platform supports business objectives. This role requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can manage CRM processes, integrations, reporting, and automation while supporting cross-functional teams.


Key Responsibilities


Daily HubSpot Administration

  • Maintain data quality across Marketing, Sales, and Service hubs
  • Manage user permissions, onboarding, and access controls
  • Perform data cleanup, duplicate management, and system maintenance
  • Monitor integrations and troubleshoot connectivity issues
  • Maintain pipelines, deal stages, and custom properties
  • Respond to internal HubSpot-related requests via Slack


Workflow & Automation

  • Create and optimise workflows for lead nurturing and sales processes
  • Build and maintain email templates, sequences, and campaigns
  • Configure lead scoring and qualification criteria
  • Manage dashboards and custom reporting


Data Management & Strategic Support

  • Ensure CRM data integrity and accurate field mapping
  • Generate reports for sales, marketing, and leadership teams
  • Maintain process and system documentation
  • Collaborate with teams to improve processes and HubSpot usage
  • Train team members on workflows and new features
  • Stay updated on HubSpot best practices and functionality


Required Qualifications

  • 1+ years of hands-on HubSpot administration experience
  • Experience with HubSpot workflows, automations, and CRM management
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and data migration
  • Strong understanding of CRM and marketing automation best practices
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • HubSpot certifications preferred
  • Experience with Zapier or similar automation tools
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email customisation
  • Previous SaaS or B2B experience is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Management Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for a Data Management Coordinator to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and supports day-to-day operations related to account setup and billing processes for our US business.


In this role, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining account records, ensuring billing information is accurate, and supporting system configurations used in pricing and invoicing.

This is a great opportunity for someone detail-oriented who enjoys working with structured processes and has an interest in systems and operational data.


Responsibilities

  • Set up and maintain account records in internal systems;
  • Ensure all billing information is complete and accurate;
  • Process incoming requests through internal tools (e.g., ticketing system);
  • Update account details, contacts, and billing structures as needed;
  • Support system updates related to pricing and billing configurations;
  • Investigate and resolve issues related to billing or data inconsistencies;
  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth operational processes;
  • Meet defined timelines and maintain high data accuracy standards.


Requirements

  • Experience in administrative, finance, accounting, or data-related roles;
  • Strong Excel skills (e.g., Pivot Tables, data comparison);
  • Professional English communication skills;
  • High attention to detail and organization;
  • Ability to follow structured processes and handle repetitive tasks.


Nice to have

  • Experience with billing, invoicing, or financial data;

title: Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is the role where attorneys stop worrying about whether anything is going to slip through the cracks. Calendars they trust. Dockets that don't drift. Court, BIA, and tribal-court filings that always go through. Billing that closes on schedule. Confidential records handled with the discretion the work requires.


Our client is a leading Arizona litigation firm headquartered in Phoenix, with active practices in commercial litigation, civil rights, employment law, and Federal Indian Law — including matters before the Bureau of Indian Affairs and tribal courts. The firm represents businesses, individuals, families, and tribal nation interests, and offers the expertise of large national firms with a smaller, more personal approach.


The firm runs on Clio for case management, calendaring, and billing. You will support attorneys and the onshore team directly — owning the operational discipline that determines whether the lawyers can focus on the law or get pulled into the operational background. This is a substantive operational ownership role, not a queue-clearing admin seat.


Success at 90 days: zero missed deadlines, calendars attorneys rely on without checking twice, clean billing close, organized matter files. Success at one year: you know BIA procedures and tribal court rules well enough that attorneys default to you for procedural questions, not the other way around.


Key Responsibilities

Docketing & Calendar Management

  • Docket hearings, court dates, filing deadlines, BIA deadlines, tribal court deadlines, and critical case milestones in Clio.
  • Set structured multi-tier reminder cascades for every deadline (30-day, 14-day, 7-day, 2-day, day-of) — never a single calendar entry.
  • Manage attorney calendars including appointments, court dates, depositions, agency hearings, internal deadlines, and travel windows.
  • Surface upcoming deadlines and scheduling conflicts to attorneys with sufficient lead time — proactively, not reactively.

Meeting, Deposition & Travel Coordination

  • Coordinate scheduling for client meetings, depositions, hearings, agency appearances, and internal team meetings.
  • Arrange travel logistics for attorneys (flights, accommodations, transportation, itineraries) for hearings and client visits.
  • Prepare deposition logistics including notices, court reporter coordination, and witness confirmation.
  • Confirm all logistics in advance and communicate relevant details to all parties.

Legal Document Preparation

  • Prepare, edit, proofread, and format pleadings, motions, briefs, correspondence, and other legal materials to filing-ready quality.
  • Ensure all documents meet applicable court, agency, and firm formatting standards before filing or distribution.
  • Maintain version control and organized document files across all active matters inside Clio.
  • Assist attorneys with drafting standard correspondence and follow-up communications as directed.

Court & Agency Filing

  • E-file with federal district courts (CM-ECF/PACER), Arizona state courts, BIA, and tribal courts as applicable.
  • Confirm acceptance of every filing via NEF or equivalent — submission is not the same as acceptance.
  • Maintain organized records of all submissions, confirmations, and proofs of service.
  • Stay current on e-filing requirements for the courts and agencies the firm uses.

Case & File Management (Clio)

  • Maintain matter records inside Clio with consistent naming conventions and complete metadata.
  • Track case activity and organize supporting documentation.
  • Maintain and organize physical and digital client files.
  • Handle confidential client records and case information with the highest level of discretion and in compliance with applicable professional responsibility rules.
  • Support case intake — opening new matters in Clio, gathering client information, preparing conflict checks.

Billing, Invoicing & Expense Tracking

  • Track attorney time entries, billing activity, and client invoices inside Clio.
  • Assist with preparation and distribution of client billing statements.
  • Process and track expense reports and reimbursements.
  • Flag missing time entries, overdue invoices, or discrepancies to the appropriate team member before billing close.

Compliance & Procedure

  • Maintain awareness of procedural rules relevant to the firm's Indian law practice — federal administrative procedures, tribal court rules, federal court local rules, BIA processes.
  • Support the firm's compliance with document retention, confidentiality, and professional responsibility obligations.
  • Ensure all administrative procedures comply with applicable legal, court, and agency requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a legal admin, legal secretary, or paralegal role supporting a US litigation practice (or strongly comparable international firm).
  • Hands-on US court e-filing experience (CM-ECF, PACER, AZTurboCourt, or similar) — direct workflow experience, not familiarity.
  • Direct experience managing multiple attorney calendars with structured, multi-tier deadline cascades.
  • Excellent written English — documents you prepare or proofread require minimal attorney correction.
  • Meticulous attention to detail. Accuracy in legal documents and deadlines is non-negotiable.
  • High discretion in handling confidential client and case information.
  • Self-directed and reliable in a remote work environment.
  • Stable home office: high-speed internet, backup power or backup internet, quiet workspace, modern computer with webcam.


Strong Plus, Not Required

  • Direct paid Clio experience — matter setup, calendar integration, document management, and billing.
  • Equivalent experience with Filevine, MyCase, ProLaw, Smokeball, or comparable case management systems.
  • Familiarity with Bureau of Indian Affairs procedures, tribal court rules, or federal administrative practice.
  • Experience with LEDES invoicing or other legal billing standards.
  • 12+ months of sustained US-firm remote experience.


How We Work

  • 100% remote.
  • full-time contractor.
  • Compensation: up to $6/hr USD.


Application

Complete the required Aptive Index assessment here and provide a comprehensive resume.

Link:


By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.


Scheduling: initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time, within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window — which translates locally to 6:00 PM – 4:00 AM in the Philippines, 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM in South Africa, 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM in Brazil, and 4:00 AM – 2:00 PM in Guatemala.

  • Contribuir para melhoria contínua da arquitetura e organização dos dados corporativos.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em modelagem de dados conceitual, lógica e física.
  • Experiência com modelagem dimensional para ambientes analíticos (Star Schema).
  • Experiência com arquitetura medallion
  • Conhecimento em normalização e otimização de estruturas de dados (modelagem até 3NF).
  • Experiência com SQL e análise de estruturas de banco.
  • Conhecimento em integração de dados e processos ETL.
  • Vivência com documentação técnica e dicionário de dados.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos estruturados.
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos e multidisciplinares.
  • Boa comunicação e interação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Forte conceito em harmonização de dados
  • Conhecimento em LGPD e segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais (conhecimento em Oracle 19c será um diferencial).

  • Trabalho Remoto.

  • Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação Saúde e Cultura.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solution Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs.

You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Why Join the Solution Architect Team?

  • Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments.
  • Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


What You’ve Accomplished So Far

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.


How You’ll Ramp Up

By Day 30

  • Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.

By Day 60

  • Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities.
  • Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews.

By Day 90

  • Own complex technical engagements end-to-end.
  • Mentor junior team members.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:

Mobile Engineer (React + React Native)


LATAM | Remote | EST-Aligned | International Independent Contractor


Compensation: USD $3,000–$4,000/month (based on experience)


About the Company


Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based technology company transforming how consumers and investors access and analyze real estate data. Their platform serves over one million users and is built around a culture of rapid experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision-making.


The team operates in a highly collaborative environment with fast development cycles, lean processes, and a strong emphasis on shipping impactful features quickly. Engineers have direct influence on product direction and regularly see their work reach production.


About the Role


We're seeking a Mobile Engineer with experience building both web and mobile applications using React and React Native. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating polished user experiences, working closely with product leadership, and contributing to applications used at scale.


You'll collaborate with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to build, enhance, and optimize both web and mobile experiences while helping shape the technical direction of a growing platform.


What You'll Do


  • Build and maintain modern web applications using React and Next.js.
  • Develop and enhance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Deliver high-quality features across web and mobile platforms with a focus on usability, performance, and reliability.
  • Optimize application performance, rendering, routing, and component architecture.
  • Collaborate with designers, product stakeholders, and backend engineers to implement new functionality.
  • Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs while ensuring efficient state management and error handling.
  • Participate in sprint planning, standups, code reviews, and ongoing product discussions.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture decisions and engineering best practices.
  • Write and maintain automated tests to support long-term application stability and maintainability.


Required Qualifications


  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience developing web applications with React .
  • Minimum 1 year of professional experience building mobile applications with React Native .
  • Strong knowledge of React.js and Next.js, including routing, SSR, SSG, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Experience developing and maintaining React Native applications for iOS and Android.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and asynchronous programming concepts.
  • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and modern UI development practices.
  • Experience working with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative product environment.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Exposure to Node.js environments such as Express or NestJS.
  • Experience working on data-intensive, analytics, marketplace, or real estate technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with mobile performance optimization and native module integrations.


What We're Looking For


  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.
  • Proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of projects and outcomes.
  • Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills.
  • Comfortable working directly with leadership and contributing ideas.
  • Adaptable and energized by fast-moving environments where iteration and continuous improvement are valued.


Work Details


Location: Latin America (Remote)

Schedule: Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST)

Employment Type: Full-Time International Independent Contractor


If you're excited about building products used by millions of users, enjoy moving quickly, and want to make a meaningful impact across both web and mobile platforms, we'd love to hear from you.

title: LATAM Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LATAM Accountant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LATAM Accountant

Brazil | Remote


About Sycomp

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.


About the Role


We are looking for a detail-oriented LATAM Accountant to support accounting operations across multiple countries in the region. This role will play a key part in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting month-end close, and ensuring compliance with GAAP, IFRS, and local statutory requirements.


You will work closely with internal finance teams and external partners, supporting day-to-day accounting activities while contributing to accurate and timely financial reporting.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the full month-end close process for assigned LATAM entities, ensuring accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare and post journal entries, reconcile balance sheet and intercompany accounts
  • Review and validate transactions across AP, AR, billing, and financial operations
  • Maintain alignment between Oracle and local statutory books
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing required documentation
  • Execute tax accounting activities and support statutory compliance across LATAM
  • Ensure adherence to internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Sales Operations, Tax, Legal, and external providers


Requirements

  • CPA (or equivalent certification) required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
  • Minimum 4 years of accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP / IFRS and accounting operations
  • Experience with AP processes and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Solid understanding of LATAM tax and statutory compliance (Brazil experience preferred)
  • Experience with ERP systems (Oracle preferred)
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
  • Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.


Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at

title: Especialista Product Designer (Remoto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Product Designer (Remoto) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Especialista em Design de Produto para atuar de forma transversal na evolução da experiência dos produtos da Suíte Logística. Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar tecnicamente iniciativas de design, elevando a qualidade visual e de interação, promovendo maior consistência entre soluções e contribuindo para a construção de uma experiência integrada de plataforma. Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade de execução, pensamento sistêmico e excelência em UX e UI, que atue como referência técnica para o time e ajude a transformar desafios complexos em experiências simples, intuitivas e de alto valor para os usuários.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução da experiência de uma plataforma composta por múltiplos produtos;
  • Atuar na construção de soluções digitais complexas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e simplicidade para os usuários;

  • Contribuir para a evolução de design systems, padrões e boas práticas;
  • Influenciar decisões de produto e experiência por meio de uma visão sistêmica e orientada ao usuário;

  • Experiência sólida em Design de Produto (UX/UI) em produtos digitais;
  • Ensino superior completo em Design, Design Digital, Design de Interação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;

  • Atuação como referência técnica, mentor ou líder de prática em times de design;
  • Experiência atuando de forma transversal em múltiplos produtos, jornadas ou domínios de negócio;

  • Domínio de processos de descoberta, definição e entrega de soluções digitais;
  • Experiência na criação de fluxos, arquitetura da informação, prototipação e interfaces;
  • Experiência conduzindo decisões de design em ambientes multidisciplinares e de alta complexidade;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com Produto, Tecnologia e demais áreas do negócio;

  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de influenciar decisões sem autoridade formal;

  • Experiência com plataformas compostas por múltiplos produtos ou ecossistemas digitais;

  • Familiaridade com inteligência artificial aplicada à experiência do usuário.

Brazil | Remote

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. title: Full Stack Engineer (React & Node)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (React & Node) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (React & Node.js) com forte experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos, arquitetura de microfrontends, sistemas distribuídos e backend escalável.


O(a) profissional ideal possui profundo conhecimento em arquitetura moderna de frontend (React 18+, Microfrontends, Zustand, React Query, Next.js) e backend robusto com Node.js e NestJS, aplicando Clean Code, SOLID, DDD e boas práticas de observabilidade.

Será responsável por desenhar soluções escaláveis, garantindo performance, confiabilidade, segurança e integração entre múltiplos sistemas.


Responsabilidades:


Frontend (React)

  • Desenvolver aplicações escaláveis com React 18+ utilizando hooks avançados e composition patterns.
  • Implementar e manter arquitetura de Microfrontends (Single-SPA) .
  • Gerenciar estados assíncronos com Zustand, zustand-pub e React Query .
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis e responsivos com Styled Components .
  • Otimizar performance (Suspense, lazy loading, memoization).
  • Implementar fluxo offline e deduplicação de requisições.
  • Configurar e otimizar Webpack 5 .
  • Desenvolver testes unitários e de integração (Jest).
  • Implementar monitoramento com Sentry, Datadog ou NewRelic.
  • Aplicar Clean Code, SOLID e DDD no frontend.
  • Integrar soluções de pagamento (Pix, boletos, gateways).
  • Atuar em ambientes com CI/CD e Docker.


Backend (Node.js / NestJS)

  • Desenvolver serviços escaláveis com Node.js (v20+) e NestJS 11+ .
  • Implementar arquitetura modular e padrão BFF.
  • Criar e manter APIs REST com retry, timeout e circuit breaker.
  • Implementar autenticação com JWT e OAuth2.
  • Garantir segurança de APIs (OWASP Top 10, rate limiting, sanitização).
  • Implementar observabilidade com Winston, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana e ELK.
  • Desenvolver testes unitários e integração com Jest e Supertest.
  • Atuar com serviços AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Functions, CloudWatch, IAM).
  • Containerizar aplicações com Docker.
  • Documentar APIs com @nestjs/swagger e versionamento adequado.



Competências Técnicas


Frontend:

  • React 18+, hooks avançados, Context API.
  • TypeScript avançado.
  • Microfrontends (Single-SPA).
  • Zustand e arquitetura Pub/Sub.
  • React Query.
  • Next.js (SSR, RSC, App Router).
  • Webpack 5.
  • Jest.
  • Gitflow ou Trunk-Based Development.

Backend:

  • Node.js (v20+).
  • NestJS 11+.
  • Arquitetura modular.
  • Interceptors, Pipes e Middleware.
  • Injeção de dependência.
  • APIs REST.
  • Logging, métricas e observabilidade.
  • AWS.
  • Docker e CI/CD.
  • Segurança de APIs.

A OSF é uma consultoria global que nasceu em Quebec, no Canadá, e hoje atua em mais de 30 países. Somos um dos maiores parceiros Salesforce do mundo.

Já nascemos no modelo remoto — esse formato faz parte da nossa cultura e está totalmente consolidado.


Nosso foco é desenvolvimento contínuo, crescimento técnico e evolução profissional.

title: Integration Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position and independent contractor (PJ).


Required Skills & Experience


• Strong hands on experience designing APIs (REST/JSON) and service based integrations

• Experience with cloud integration platforms and middleware solutions

• Deep understanding of integration patterns (sync/async, event driven, pub/sub, orchestration, transformation)

• Experience with security concepts including OAuth, JWT, certificates, encryption, and secure data exchange

• Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud, Azure Integration Services

• Experience with API Management platforms

• Knowledge of messaging and event platforms (Service Bus, queues, topics)


Job Description


The Integration Architect is responsible for collaborating on the design, architecture, and governance of enterprise integration solutions across cloud, SaaS, on prem, and partner ecosystems with guidance from the Enterprise Integration Architect . This role bridges business and IT by translating business needs into scalable, secure, and resilient integration architectures, while establishing standards, patterns, and best practices across the integration landscape. The Integration Architect partners closely with engineering teams, product owners, enterprise architecture, and business stakeholders to enable reliable data exchange, real time integrations, and future ready platform capabilities.


Job Duties:

• Design and architect enterprise-wide integrations across:

o Cloud, SaaS, ERP, and partner systems

• Build and maintain:

o Integration patterns, standards, and reusable frameworks

• Lead architectural decisions using:

o APIs, event-driven architecture, messaging, middleware

• Create documentation:

o Solution designs, sequence diagrams, data flows

• Provide oversight to:

o Engineering and delivery teams

• Translate business needs into:

o Scalable technical integration solutions

• Ensure integrations meet:

o Performance, security, reliability, and monitoring standards

• Partner cross-functionally:

o Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Data teams
